LanguageData.LP_MarilithCore.label: serpent body origin
LanguageData.LP_MarilithCore.description: The marilith bloodline: above the waist a six-armed humanoid, below the waist a thick serpent tail. Body size 1.6 (drawn about 1.3×). Each shoulder grows two extra arms (if one side's shoulder is lost or replaced with a prosthetic, that side's extra arms are gone too); each extra hand gives manipulation +10%. The serpent tail replaces both legs, so pants, greaves and shoes can't be worn. A cold-blooded race, most at ease in warm weather.
LanguageData.LP_MarilithCore.customEffectDescriptions: Body size 1.6 (drawn about 1.3×), children grow with age.
Two extra arms on each shoulder: each usable extra hand gives manipulation +10% (+40% with all four).
A serpent tail instead of legs: clothes covering only the legs and feet can't be worn.
LanguageData.LP_MarilithBlades.label: six-armed flurry
LanguageData.LP_MarilithBlades.description: Requires more than two arms. Melee weapons in the pack are taken up as off-hands by the extra arms: one per usable pair of extra arms (up to two, picking the best). While the main hand holds a melee weapon or is empty, each normal melee hit is followed by a strike from each off-hand (damage per mod settings, 50% by default). No effect on someone with only two arms.
LanguageData.LP_MarilithBlades.customEffectDescriptio: Requires more than two arms (no effect on humans).
Off-hands: the melee weapons in the pack with the highest quality × DPS, one per usable pair of extra arms (up to 2).
After a normal melee hit, each off-hand follows up with a strike; doesn't trigger when the main hand holds a ranged weapon or on ability hits.
LanguageData.LP_SerpentGlide.label: serpentine glide
LanguageData.LP_SerpentGlide.description: The serpent tail glides along the ground, and mud, marsh and shallow water can't hold it back: movement cost on these terrains is halved.
LanguageData.LP_SerpentGlide.customEffectDescriptions: Terrain movement cost of mud, marsh and shallow water halved (doesn't affect pathfinding detour decisions).
LanguageData.LP_SerpentConstrict.label: constrict
LanguageData.LP_SerpentConstrict.description: Wrap an adjacent enemy with the serpent tail (or long arms): it can't move for 3 seconds and takes 6 blunt damage per second (adjusted by the size ratio of both, ×0.5 to ×2); you can't move while constricting either. Cooldown 12 hours.
LanguageData.LP_BladeStorm.label: blade storm
LanguageData.LP_BladeStorm.description: Swing all arms at once: against each enemy within 1 cell, the main hand and every usable off-hand attack once. Cooldown 2 days. Off-hands require extra arms; with only two arms there's just the main-hand strike.
LanguageData.LP_AbyssalHide.label: abyssal body
LanguageData.LP_AbyssalHide.description: Scales grown in the fire seas and ice caverns of the Abyss: fire, burn, frostbite and electrical damage taken ×75%, toxic resistance +50%.
LanguageData.LP_ColdBlood.label: cold-blooded
LanguageData.LP_ColdBlood.description: A cold-blooded body follows the weather: move speed ×85% when the ambient temperature is below 0°C.
LanguageData.LP_ColdBlood.customEffectDescriptions.0: Move speed ×85% when the ambient temperature is below 0°C.
LanguageData.LP_SkinSerpentTeal.label: teal scales
LanguageData.LP_SkinSerpentDark.label: ink-green scales
LanguageData.LP_SkinSerpentDark.description: A marilith's deep ink-green scaly hide.
LanguageData.LP_SkinSerpentGold.label: red-gold scales
LanguageData.LP_SkinSerpentGold.description: A marilith's red-gold scaly hide with a metallic sheen.
